datos.historiasBajada: Every statement that claims a change or a difference rests on one of these tests. In each row, the vertical line is zero, the dot is the difference, and the horizontal line is its {{p95}} interval. If the line crosses zero, the row says “no clear difference” and the story does not pick a winner.
